name: brandsync-angular-storybook
description: Storybook showcase for @brandsync/angular. A workspace member of this monorepo. @brandsync/angular below is a `file:` dependency pointing at packages/angular/dist specifically (NOT the ambient npm-workspaces auto-link, which would resolve to packages/angular's own SOURCE package.json -- ng-packagr builds Angular's publishable artifact, with its own separate generated package.json/main/module fields, one level deeper into dist/, same nuance documented in packages/wc's scripts/publish.sh). Still goes through the real built output, same as an npm-registry install would.
